mira.k: Quick draft of release notes & plan for the sprint launch. Pls review and add owners. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC tonight. Canary deploy at 23:10. Rollback if error rate >0.5% or p99 latency +200ms. Draft below:

mira.k: ```
Release v2.3.1
- Improve batching heuristics for small requests (reduce cost)
- Fix KV cache eviction bug causing stale prefixes
- Add per-route cost breakdown in console
Known issues: minor UI flicker in Console on Safari
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: /deploy canary v2.3.1 -> gpu-pool-2 at 2025-03-20T23:10:00Z :rocket:

kevin: ack. i'll take on canary watch (alerts & logs). I'll post slackops snippet 10m before.

alex: i'll update internal RN doc with short blurb and callouts for SRE playbook. ping me if wording needs tone-down.

julie (prod-ops): i'll own rollout comms. channel announcement ready. change-window approved.

sre-oncall: rollback trigger clarified — also abort on sustained KV miss >1% for 2m. who's running rollback?

kevin: if triggers hit, i'll run `/deploy rollback v2.3.1` and coordinate with julie for comms.

sam (product): small copy tweak: change 'per-route cost' -> 'token-level cost breakdown' in RN. ok to update.

mira.k: done — updated draft. final owners: kevin (canary & rollback), julie (comms), alex (RN docs), sam (product sign-off). Anyone else?

kevin: i'll push a tiny smoke test that hits realtime routes at 23:05.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2025-03-20T23:10:12Z. Instances: 4/4. Monitoring: enabled. :eyes:

mira.k: thanks — i'll be on standby during window. post any anomalies here and tag @sre-oncall. :thumbsup:
